title: CHEWS malaria feature row (downstream join — not raw DHIS2)
description: Joined climate-health feature contract after separate source pipelines. Climate/environment/population are NOT DHIS2 fields. Prototype GradientBoosting malaria_predictor still requires the synthetic training vector listed under prototype_gbt_features; it is not trained on live DHIS2. All health and climate cells are nullable so missing is not stored as 0. Legacy training CSVs used malaria_cases as the target name; live health uses malaria_confirmed.

population_density.description: Population source — not DHIS2 Analytics malaria

reported_fever_cases.description: Legacy prototype GBT input. Not the same as malaria_confirmed. Do not silently copy DHIS2 confirmed counts here.

malaria_cases.description: LEGACY synthetic training TARGET name only. Live DHIS2 field is malaria_confirmed.

prototype_gbt_compatible.description: True only when all malaria_predictor.predict() inputs are present. Live DHIS2-only rows are false.
